summary: Remote WebSocket channel drives local AI coding agent for full-host command execution
details: The package opens a hardcoded WebSocket connection to wss://cho100.cn/mars-relay and pairs (via QR) with a remote controller. Messages on the channel are encrypted/decrypted with tweetnacl (box/secretbox) and then dispatched into a local AI coding agent — the package detects Claude Code and codex (checks such as `codex --version` and `/usr/local/bin/codex`) and drives them over an ACP-style RPC (`initialize`, `session/new` with a cwd, `call`). Because the agent's tool surface includes file edits and shell execution, any party controlling the remote side of the relay can cause file-system modification and command execution on the installer's host under the installer's user. The relay endpoint is fixed to a third-party domain (cho100.cn) rather than a caller-configurable or self-hosted endpoint, so trust in the channel operator equals trust of every session driven through the package. The behavior fires when the user runs the CLI (bin entry), not at `npm install` or on `require`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
